title: The Guru Prepares Khalsa Succession at Chamkaur

blocks.text: As evening fell after the battle of Chamkaur, the Mughal commanders ringed the fortress so tightly that onlookers thought there was no possible path of escape left for the Guru. (1–4)
Guru Gobind Singh reflected on the martyrdom of his sons and the collapse of almost all remaining strength inside the fort, then spoke of having returned the Divine gift back to its Giver. (5–6)
Out of that crisis the Guru resolved to entrust the Khalsa with guruship, preparing to seat Sant Singh in his place and pass forward the visible signs of leadership. (7–8)
